# Local AI Video Studio

> A local-first Mac studio for comparing reproducible video-effect variants before export.

## Product

- [Home](https://local-ai-video-studio.sassmaker.com/): Product workflow and release status
- [System](https://local-ai-video-studio.sassmaker.com/#system): Local processing and validation boundary
- [Release](https://local-ai-video-studio.sassmaker.com/#release): Distribution readiness and system requirements

## Machine surfaces

- [Agent catalog](https://local-ai-video-studio.sassmaker.com/api/ai): JSON inventory of public surfaces
- [OpenAPI spec](https://local-ai-video-studio.sassmaker.com/openapi.json): Machine-readable API description
- [Homepage markdown](https://local-ai-video-studio.sassmaker.com/index.md): Product brief without JS
- [This index](https://local-ai-video-studio.sassmaker.com/llms.txt)

## When to use this

- Comparing reproducible video-effect variants locally before export on Mac
- Understanding the local-first processing and validation boundary for video effects
- Checking distribution readiness and system requirements for a Mac video studio
- Exploring a Swift/SwiftUI-based local AI video production workflow
